property_summary: For any caller and calldata, when the owner calls Command forwarding some ETH to a callee that reverts, the reference contract does not revert (it ignores the callee failure) while the mutant that requires the call's success will revert; therefore the reference always allows the Command call to succeed with a reverting callee, but the mutant fails for some inputs (when the callee reverts).
change_summary: Replace low-level call without checking return value with a require around the call result so the call must succeed (revert on failure).
